missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Руководство' is the neuter nominative as the subject of 'приняло'. 'Новое' agrees in the neuter, and 'решение' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Руководство' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'критикуют', identical to the nominative. 'Компании' is a genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Genitive after от. 'Руководства' is the genitive form required by 'от', marking what the outcome depends on. 'Это' is the neuter nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Руководству' is the dative form required by 'доверять', which governs the dative. 'Нашему' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of agent. 'Руководством' is the instrumental form marking who runs the plant in the passive 'управляется'. 'Опытным' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В руководстве' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to mean within the leadership. 'Перемены' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after под. 'Руководством' is the instrumental form required by 'под', meaning under his leadership. 'Завод' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Руководства' is the nominative plural here in the sense of manuals, the subject of 'устарели'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Руководство' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'прочитал' in the sense of a manual. 'Пользователя' is a genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Руководства' is the genitive form modifying 'стиль', meaning leadership style. 'Стиль' is the nominative subject of 'изменился'.
